title: Command & Conquer 4: Tiberian Twilight
notes: Campaign achievements come from your profile settings file (Options.ini), which the game updates after each mission. Vault never touches the game.
Campaign on Hard counts missions finished while the campaign difficulty is set to Hard, after Vault has seen your profile once.

Skirmish achievements come from the replay the game saves after every game (Documents\Command & Conquer 4 Tiberian Twilight\Replays). Replays do not record who won, so these are about playing, not winning. Games shorter than 3 minutes do not count.

testGuide.title: Beat a campaign mission
testGuide.detail: Finish the first GDI or Nod mission and return to the menu. Its achievement should pop.
